email.subject: Quality complaint PO-26-1083 - porosity
email.body:
Dear Ms Mazur,

our incoming inspection found porosity (shrinkage cavities) in 38 of the 600 housings delivered under PO-26-1083. The parts are blocked. Please send us an 8D report by 24.07. and replace the 38 pcs with the remaining delivery.

Photos are attached.

Kind regards
Alex Morgan

facts: 38 of 600 housings from PO-26-1083 show porosity
replace the 38 pcs with the remaining delivery
